NAME ________________________________________________ADM No: _______________
COMPUTER STUDIES
451/2
(PRACTICAL)
TIME: 2½ HOURS
INSTRUCTIONS TO CANDIDATES
 Write your name and Adm No on each print out.
 Write your name and Adm No number on the storage medium provided.
 Write the name and version of software used for each question attempted.
 Passwords should not be used while saving in your work.
 This paper consists of two questions
 Answer all the questions.
 All questions carry equal marks.
 All answers must be saved in your storage medium
 Hand in all the print outs and the storage medium
 This paper consists of 3 printed pages
 Candidates should check to ensure the two questions are printed as stated.
QUESTION 1
You have been contracted as an ICT expert to help in analysing Githunguri joint mock exam. Using
Microsoft excel create a new workbook and name it as Githunguri.jMocks.
 A B C D E F G H
 REG NO.
 EXAM1
 EXAM2
 EXAM3
 TOTAL
 NAME
 MEAN
 CLASS
 2 Tina Mwenda LION 6984 80 72 60
 3 Seth Mwaura CHEATAH 7896 75 55 72
 4 Ben Odhiambo ZEBRA 8092 84 58 75
 5 Catrinah Kosgei LEOPARD 7460 80 79 70
 6 Richard Mucee LION 6892 76 75 80
 7 Hassan Hali TIGER 8800 38 48 25
 8 Mary Otiende CHEATAH 7490 37 51 29
 9 Paul Wanyonyi ZEBRA 9184 30 86 75
 10 Derrick Omar LION 6082 25 27 28
 11 Waithera Njoki ZEBRA 9033 30 25 25
 12 Serafina Njoroge TIGER 8047 39 24 25
 a) Enter the above data in sheet 1 (13mks)
 b) Rename sheet 1 as mock. (1mk)
 c) Copy the content of sheet 1 to sheet 2 and rename it as Evaluation. (1mk)
 d) Using cell references only calculate the:
 i. Totals (2mks)
 ii. Average (The values should be to 3 decimal places) (3mks)
 e) Insert a row above the column labels, merge cells, type the title, ”CLUSTER MOCKS” AND
 format it as follows:
 i) Font type; Corbel
 ii) Font size 16.
 iii) Center align the title.
 iv) The other subtitles should be rotated 65 degrees, bolded and italised. (5mks)
 f) Use a function to award remarks to the students as follows (3mks)
 MEAN REMARKS
 >65 Gold
 55 – 64 Silver
 <54 Bronze
 g) Insert a column showing RANK award positions to students based on the means. (3mks)
 h) On the last rows enter a function to display the total of students from each class.(2mks)
 i) Sort the students list by class position in ascending order. (2mks)
 j) Copy the entire worksheet onto worksheet 3 and rename it ‘SHAZA_GIRLS’. (2mks)
 k) Filter SHAZA_ GIRLS worksheet to show student(s) from ‘ZEBRA’ class and whose mean
 score is more than 50. (2mks)
 l) Insert a bar graph to display the three exams and names. (1mk)
m) Title of the graph, ”Githunguri Joint Mocks” and label the X-axis as marks and Y-axis as
 names. (3mks)
n) Place the legend at the bottom of the graph. (1mk)
o) Save the chart on a new sheet and name it ‘MOCK ANALYSIS’. (1MK)
p) Print the four worksheets. (4mks)
QUESTION TWO
a) Open a DTP package, set the page properties as follows. (4mks)
 i) Margins – 0.5 cm all round
 ii) Page layout – landscape
 iii) Page size – A4
b) Create the following advertisement and save it as GOLF_ ADVERT. (44mks)
c) Print GOLF_ ADVERT. (2mks)
